fullDesc: Tesla opened its Gigafactory in Nevada in 2016 to make batteries on a huge scale with Panasonic. It was part of a push to make electric cars affordable.
realFacts: It was one of the largest buildings in the world by footprint
Tesla now has factories in China, Germany and Texas
Battery costs fell by about 90 percent over a decade
Musk's goal was 500,000 cars a year
